description: Hand parts of a task to sub-agents that work at the same time, and get their reports back: for work that splits into independent parts in different apps or sites (compare a price in three shops, gather facts from several places). Each sub-agent is an agent like you with the phone tools, on a hidden screen of its own, so the user keeps their screen and you keep yours. Sub-agents only look things up: they can't send, post, buy, delete, change settings or ask the user, so do those steps yourself afterwards. Give each a different app or site (an app can only be open in one place) and a task that stands on its own: a sub-agent knows nothing of this conversation. The call waits for the reports (up to 8 minutes; then subagents gives the rest). When you have a part of your own to do meanwhile (in another app), pass wait false: the sub-agents start, you work at the same time, and subagents collects their reports when you are done. Give as many tasks as the work has parts: they all start at once. Each sub-agent uses the user's plan as you do, so don't delegate what you can do quickly yourself, and never a step whose result you need before you can go on: a lone sub-agent you only wait for is slower than doing it yourself.

name.description: A few words the user sees, e.g. "Amazon"

phone.description: Default true. False for a part that needs no app (the web, files, thinking): that sub-agent takes no phone screen

task.description: Everything the sub-agent needs: what to find, where, and what to report back

wait.description: Default true: wait here for the reports. False: return at once, so you can work on your own part at the same time; call subagents afterwards.

name: delegate
